title: 第十章战猪妖
slug: 开局阴阳宗从反杀师姐开始斩妖除魔
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

张守安立刻回剑格挡，堪堪挡下那冲来的拳头，发出一道脆响，身体也由于惯性，接连后退几步。

他气息乱了几分，但还是很快调整好，摆好架势，望向猪妖的身影。

练气圆满的猪妖，还会用功法，防御根本破不开……张守安心里推断，脑中快速思考着解决办法。

但猪妖可不会给他时间，一拳再次袭来。

张守安只能再次出剑抵挡，手臂都因为那强大的冲击力而有些发麻。

终于，张守安一个疏忽，一拳再次袭来，重重地砸在张守安身上。

张守安闷哼一声，倒飞而出，幸亏有青光护体，帮他卸下了大片力度，他才不至于再次砸到墙上，而是在一段距离后，停了下来。

他感受着青光下隐隐作痛的身体，倒吸了一口凉气。

既然打不过，那就不装了。

系统，我要推演。

【道行值：154】

【道行值-100】

【开始推演】

【推演功法品级：练气】

【目前选项：】

【1.基础剑法】

【2.白青罡气】

【3.阴阳合欢功】

张守安没有犹豫，立刻选择了基础剑法。

他现在就需要一部攻击的招式，来破开猪妖身上的金光。

他现在的基础剑法，还是有些不够用了。

【开始推演】

【鉴于宿主目前遭遇，自动推演出新的功法】

【功法名称：】

【荡魔剑法（入门）】

系统，加满……张守安心思一动，道行值开始减少。

【道行值-30】

脑海中的那道人影重新出现，他一手执剑，身着一件灰色长衣，衣角无风自动，慢慢晃荡。

忽然，他开始舞剑，长剑刺出，而后上挑，剑尖在空中划过一道弧线，但还没收住，他脚下动作变换，第二剑已至。

Page (1/3)

Zhang Shou'an immediately returned his sword to block, barely able to block the oncoming fist, making a crisp sound, and his body also took several steps back due to inertia.

His breath was a little confused, but he quickly adjusted himself, got into a good posture, and looked at the figure of the pig demon.

The pig demon who has perfected Qi training can also use kung fu techniques, and his defense cannot be broken at all... Zhang Shou'an reasoned in his mind, thinking quickly about solutions in his mind.

But the pig demon wouldn't give him time, and struck again with a punch.

Zhang Shou'an could only use his sword to resist again, his arms numb from the powerful impact.

Finally, Zhang Shou'an made a mistake and punched Zhang Shou'an again, hitting Zhang Shou'an hard.

Zhang Shou'an grunted and flew backwards. Fortunately, the green light shield helped him relieve a large amount of force, so he did not hit the wall again, but stopped after a distance.

He felt the dull pain in his body under the blue light and took a deep breath.

Since you can't beat it, then stop pretending.

System, I want to deduce.

[Tao Xing Value: 154]

[Dao Xing Value-100]

【Start deduction】

[Deduction of Kung Fu Level: Qi Training]

[Current options:]

【1.Basic swordsmanship】

【2.Bai Qinggang Qi】

【3. Yin Yang He Huan Gong】

Zhang Shou'an did not hesitate and immediately chose the basic sword technique.

He now needs an attack move to break through the golden light on the pig demon.

His current basic swordsmanship is still somewhat inadequate.

【Start deduction】

[In view of the host’s current encounter, new techniques are automatically deduced]

[Exercise name:]

[Dang Demon Sword Technique (Introductory)]

System, refill... Zhang Shou'an thought about it, and his Taoist values began to decrease.

[Daoxing value-30]

The figure in his mind reappeared. He held a sword in one hand and was wearing a long gray coat. The corners of the garment automatically swayed in the absence of wind.

Suddenly, he started to dance with his sword, thrust out the long sword, then raised it, the tip of the sword drew an arc in the air, but before it could be caught, the movements of his feet changed, and the second sword had arrived.
